title: boat-owner-is-read-not-stated
intention: cairn.devices.harbor_master.clearance.clear() obtains boat_owner from the BOAT rather than from its caller, so the Law 6 refusal cannot be satisfied by a caller choosing its own arguments.
why: The lived symptom, in the hands of whoever comes next: read cairn/devices/harbor_master/clearance.py and you are told the gate refuses an actor who is not the boat's owner and holds no grant — the sentence harbor_master's whole charter rests on. Then call it. Your call refuses; you change one string to match another string you also typed; your call passes. Nothing consulted the boat. A future device advancing a boat it has no business touching passes the same way, because it too will state both sides. The refusal is real code that runs and returns the answer its caller asked for.
traces_to: Law 6 (everything has exactly one owner; the owner alone gates writes — a check whose owner is supplied by the writer is not a gate)
Law 4 (a rule that matters is enforced by physics, not policy — a caller-satisfiable check is policy wearing physics' clothes)
Law 3 (nothing is known until measured — this was found by firing it, not by reading it; four readers had read past it)

falsifier.proves_green: code-seam@v2 gate-set, transcribed. PROVEME (non-skippable): proofs beside the code at cairn/devices/harbor_master/proofs/, run twice, sealed under the tester with isolation='netns' and persisted through validation_store.persist_validation. The Law 8 teeth: (i) a caller stating actor == boat_owner for a boat it does not own is REFUSED — the tooth that is GREEN TODAY on the reverted code, which is why non-hollowness here is proved by reverting and watching it PASS, the mirror of the usual direction and stated so nobody checks the wrong sign; (ii) the rightful owner still clears, so the read did not simply deny everyone; (iii) the read answers from files only — a tooth asserting no device, bus or network call is reachable from clear(). BUILD GATE: the PROVEME crossing runs build_inspector over cairn/devices/harbor_master at its own address. FEEDBACK TO ORIGIN ON FAILURE (Law 3+8 invariant): a red routes back to this ticket and to cairn/devices/harbor_master/intention+why.json, whose own falsifier is the sentence about devices advancing workflows around the rung — a failure here is evidence about that sentence.
falsifier.proves_red: DONE when cairn.devices.harbor_master.clearance.clear() obtains boat_owner from the BOAT rather than from its caller, and a tooth proves that a caller naming an actor with no standing over that boat is refused EVEN THOUGH it supplied a boat_owner equal to its own actor — verified non-hollow by reverting the read and watching the tooth go green (the reverted direction is green here, which is the tell: today's code passes that call). RED on any of: (1) the boat's owner ends up supplied by the caller under a new name — the same hole wearing a different field; (2) the read makes the gate reach outward at a crossing (a device roster, a live registry) — the chokepoint answers from files, and a registry is out of bounds by the parent ticket's own constrain; (3) every boat's owner resolves to the same string, which is the check being vacuous by a longer route. HORIZON: the first crossing made by an actor that is NOT the box's single hand — a second device, or Akien acting directly. Until such a crossing exists the refusal cannot be observed firing on anything real, and that is stated here rather than discovered later.
